memories.gist: I learned the forge under an old smith whose name I rarely say aloud.
Synthetic legacy note: the iron for the town gate came from the northern pass.
The visitor says the bridge toll is going up.
The visitor carried a sack of coal into my forge without being asked.

recent_dialogue.speaker: player
recent_dialogue.text: I heard the bridge toll is going up.

recent_dialogue.speaker: npc
recent_dialogue.text: Is it? Tolls only ever climb.

recent_dialogue.speaker: player
recent_dialogue.text: Let me carry that coal for you.

recent_dialogue.speaker: npc
recent_dialogue.text: Well, that is kind of you.

recent_events: A cart rattled past the forge at midday.

memories.gist: The visitor asked after my husband.
The visitor says wolves were seen near the north road.

recent_dialogue.speaker: player
recent_dialogue.text: Is Garrin at the forge today?

recent_dialogue.speaker: player
recent_dialogue.text: Wolves were seen near the north road.

safety.text: Someone shoved me hard in the lane.

recent_social.text: Bring the coal in before dark.

safety.text: I heard shouting near the south gate.
